user.title: Sign in to WaterH
user.description: Use the email and password for your WaterH app account. If you signed up with Google or Facebook, set a password first with "Forgot password" in the WaterH app. Your password is only used to get a login token and is not stored.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to WaterH again
reauth_confirm.description: WaterH no longer accepts the saved login for {email}. Enter your password to sign in again.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the WaterH servers.

abort.already_configured: This WaterH account is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: That login belongs to a different WaterH account.

init.title: WaterH options
init.description: Choose how volumes are shown: follow Home Assistant's unit system, follow the unit set in the WaterH app, or pick mL or fl. oz. Leave the client ID and secret empty to use the built-in values; only fill them in if WaterH changes the values in their app (see the README).

log_drink.name: Log drink
log_drink.description: Adds a manual drink to your WaterH log, like the + button in the WaterH app.

config_entry_id.name: WaterH account
config_entry_id.description: Only needed if you have more than one WaterH account set up.

unit.name: Unit
unit.description: Unit of the amount. Defaults to the unit chosen in the integration options.

time.name: Time
time.description: When you drank it. Defaults to now.

delete_drink.name: Delete drink
delete_drink.description: Removes an entry from your WaterH log. The ID of the most recent drink is the drink_id attribute of the Last drink sensor.

config_entry_id.name: WaterH account
config_entry_id.description: Only needed if you have more than one WaterH account set up.

drink_id.name: Drink ID
drink_id.description: ID of the log entry to remove.

multiple_entries.message: More than one WaterH account is set up; choose one with config_entry_id.

invalid_amount.message: Amount must be between 1 mL and 10,000 mL (got {amount_ml} mL).

set_goal_failed.message: WaterH didn't accept the new goal: {error}
